case.title: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH. Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor. Need: 30000 kits a year. Category goal: routine: fewer suppliers and less process cost. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 5 days). Fallback if you walk away: today's terms continue unchanged. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

messages.from_name: Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH
messages.subject: Quote from Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are delighted to submit our offer for your consideration. We can offer you a price of €5.74 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, and a contract term of 12 months.

As a valued partner, we always strive to support your operations with our extensive inventory and reliable delivery service. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our successful business relationship and standing by as your trusted partner for all your supply needs.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
messages.body:
Dear Mr Stadler,

You wrote that you want to keep supporting our operations with reliable delivery, and that is exactly why we are bringing you a larger share of our fastener kit. This is business on top of what you supply us today, with a binding volume that gives your plant steady load, and Option A secures it.

On the cost side:
Our forecast for Hex bolt ISO 4017 M12x40 8.8, zinc rises 6.0% (fc:360010@2026-09).

On our past orders of the bolt:
Our orders of Hex bolt ISO 4017 M12x40 8.8, zinc with you were placed at EUR 12.46 per 100 units on 2024-09-30 (po:4500011486-10), EUR 12.46 per 100 units on 2025-05-26 (po:4500012506-10), EUR 12.46 per 100 units on 2026-01-26 (po:4500013479-10) and EUR 12.46 per 100 units on 2026-09-30 (po:4500014475-10): the price has been unchanged.

On our past orders of the nut:
Our orders of Hex nut ISO 4032 M12 8, zinc with you were placed at EUR 4.91 per 100 units on 2024-09-30 (po:4500011486-20), EUR 4.91 per 100 units on 2025-06-02 (po:4500012538-10), EUR 4.91 per 100 units on 2026-01-30 (po:4500013504-10) and EUR 4.91 per 100 units on 2026-09-28 (po:4500014466-10): the price has been unchanged.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 5.18; payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 5.13; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 5.15; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.
Binding volume in every option: 30,000 units a year over 24 months.

Option A is the package we can approve. It gives your plant the longest-planned, steady volume in return for a price and payment term that fit the long-standing prices on both parts. If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

As this goes beyond a normal price round, we would be grateful if you would take Option A to the person who decides on your side.

Thank you for taking this forward.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.from_name: Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH
messages.subject: Re: Quote from Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. As the authorized representative for this negotiation, I have carefully reviewed your proposal and the historical pricing data provided. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We received a lot of material; we looked at what bears on this part. 

We welcome the 24-month binding volume and have factored this commitment into our revised calculation. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to? Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2594, LCI-C. 

Our current Angebot is a price of €5.60 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. To offer you the most competitive rate, we have chosen your Option B with a 45-day payment term, allowing us to propose a unit price of EUR 5.58. As an alternative, we offer a price of €5.58 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months. 

This proposal stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
messages.body:
Dear Mr Stadler,

You asked which volume we can commit to, and the options below answer it: a binding volume in every option, with Option A securing steady load for your plant over the full contract term, on top of what you supply us today.

On your cost drivers, here is how this part has behaved for us:
Our orders of Washer ISO 7089 M12, zinc with you were placed at EUR 12.78 per 1,000 units on 2024-10-10 (po:4500011536-10), EUR 12.78 per 1,000 units on 2025-06-11 (po:4500012581-10), EUR 12.78 per 1,000 units on 2026-01-29 (po:4500013501-10) and EUR 12.78 per 1,000 units on 2026-09-28 (po:4500014466-20): the price has been unchanged.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 5.19; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 5.21; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 5.25; payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months.
Binding volume in every option: 30,000 units a year over 24 months.

Option A is the package we can approve.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

Since you may need a colleague's approval, here is a short paragraph for the person who decides. Option A gives Leitner & Sohn a binding volume over a fixed contract term, more of our fastener kit with one trusted supplier, and steady load for the plant, with a fair price for both family companies and a clear order to follow on confirmation.

Could you take Option A to that person and let us know the outcome? We would be glad to build this next step together with you.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor

Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2594, LCI-C. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to? This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH
